resources.string: Your apps and settings are just where you left them.

string-array.name: whatsnew_new
string-array.item: A new home: the clock widget in three sizes with Alarm, Timer and Stopwatch
A new app drawer: swipe up, recent apps on top and an A–Z letter rail
Pick widgets with live previews, at the size they will have
A Recorder widget in two sizes: record in one tap
Frosted glass under the drawer, folders and the widget picker
Kiro Speaker Engine: bass you can feel, louder and clean
kAI in the cloud: smarter, faster answers, 300 requests every 5 hours
kAI\'s new natural voice, on the phone and offline (Italian and English)
New 3D icons
New silk wallpapers: Midnight, Graphite and Dawn, to pick during setup
KeurStore 3: a new design, a page for every app, updates with size and what is new
KiroOS apps can be updated from KeurStore between system updates
Hold Power to open kAI; press Power to close it
Display > Navigation bar: on-screen keys on or off, no restart
Hold the clock in the status bar to show the seconds
Recommended apps during setup: Google Maps from the Play Store

string-array.name: whatsnew_improvements
string-array.item: The power menu opens only with Power + Volume up, never by holding Power
Volume up no longer changes the volume when you open the power menu
System apps and the Play Store cannot be removed or disabled by mistake
Google Maps takes the place of Atlas
kAI understands your voice better (speech recognition in the cloud)
The Gallery opens faster

string-array.name: whatsnew_optimizations
string-array.item: The update is 1.25 GB smaller (the on-device chat models are gone)
Kiro apps draw less on screen: smoother scrolling
kAI uses less battery in the background

string-array.name: whatsnew_fixes
string-array.item: kAI\'s voice no longer stops after the first word: it reads the whole answer
The clock widget no longer goes blank when resized
No more distortion with Kiro Sound bass at the maximum and the bass EQ
Loud peaks no longer get past the speaker protection
